title: One ultrasonic measurement for non-invasive and whole-life-cycle thermal diagnosis of lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7894-7904
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01892G, Paper
Lingshi Zhang, Zhongbao Wei, Chunxia Liu, Hongwen He, Kailong Liu, Guangmin Zhou, Yunhui Huang, Zhichuan J. Xu
A novel ultrasonic approach combining non-invasive temperature measurement, heat capacity calibration and early warning of thermal runaway, enabling the whole-life-cycle thermal evaluation of batteries with a single ultrasonic system.
